title: Pioneer History of Milwaukee — Joseph Porthier migration chronology
citation: James S. Buck, Pioneer History of Milwaukee, vol. 1 (Milwaukee, 1876), early-settlement chronology describing Horace Chase and Joseph Porthier's February–March 1835 travel from Chicago to Milwaukee.
notes: Retrospective local history; useful because it gives precise travel dates. Treat exact dates as strong migration evidence while retaining source-age caveat.
